What they do

About Rosa Divina Adornment

Rosa Divina (formerly Autumn Essence Creations) is intentional handmade adornment devoted to the reclamation of your highest self.

We offer timeless handwoven talismans and ritual wear that invite you to embody your radiance, sovereignty and innate power. We believe adornment is not separate from self-empowerment — what we choose to wear can become a reflection of what we are ready to embody.

Each talisman is handcrafted with ethically sourced gemstones, and our clothing collection is handmade with natural, sustainable or recycled fabrics. Our adornment honours the Divine Feminine within us all.
